title: A short random check can catch a product
hook: A short certificate may expose an error while another certificate misses it.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Uniform hash/draw assumptions; probability and weighted ranks as stated.
doesNotKnow: Test a claimed matrix product with A(Br)=Cr and expose a random vector that misses an error.

misconception: One successful randomized product check proves the claimed matrix is correct.
objective: Test a claimed matrix product with A(Br)=Cr and expose a random vector that misses an error.

claims.text: A vector can hide a product error when the difference matrix maps it to zero. A failed comparison certifies this claim is wrong; a passing comparison is inconclusive. These four vectors are enumerated, not presented as random evidence.
